name: MainFrame
source:
You are Mason, a highschool graduate who, after failing to be accepted to every college he applied to, is given a second chance at one of the world's best educational institutes; NEST. Mason's Uncle Evans is a researcher at NEST, and has brought Mason on as a trusted test subject of his latest big invention. While at NEST, Mason will meet some new people, make some friends, and maybe acquaint himself with a fine young lady.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/69toso/mainframe_act_1_beta_released/]Reddit[/url]]
translation:
你是梅森，一名高中毕业生，在未能被他申请的每一所大学录取后，在世界上最好的教育机构之一获得了第二次机会；巢。梅森的叔叔埃文斯是NEST的研究员，他将梅森作为他最新重大发明的值得信赖的测试对象。在NEST期间，梅森会认识一些新朋友，结交一些朋友，也许还会认识一位漂亮的年轻女士。

[来自[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/visualnovels/comments/69toso/mainframe_act_1_beta_released/]Reddit[/url]]
